title: Private Zion and Bryce Canyon Tour from Las Vegas
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Not recommended for travelers with poor cardiovascular health
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Experience two of America’s most iconic national parks in one unforgettable private day trip from Las Vegas: Zion National Park and Bryce Canyon National Park.

Enjoy Zion’s towering red cliffs and dramatic canyon scenery, then continue to Bryce Canyon, famous for its unique orange hoodoos and otherworldly landscapes.

This is a fully private tour with your own driver-guide, allowing you to travel comfortably at your own pace without sharing with other guests.

Itinerary :
・04:00–05:00 AM Depart from your hotel in Las Vegas
・07:00 AM Arrive in Utah area – short break (approx. 15 min)
・08:00 AM Zion National Park(approx. 2.5 hours)
・12:00 PM Drive from Zion to Bryce Canyon area 
・12:30 PM Lunch stop along the way 
・12:30–3:30 PM Bryce Canyon National Park (approx. 3 hours)
・3:30 PM Depart for Las Vegas (approx. 4–4.5 hours drive)
・7:30–8:30 PM Arrive back in Las Vegas
